```{r MULTI FS RF FUNCTION PROTOTYPE}
rf_control_function = function(df,
                               target,
                               k1,
                               k2,
                               num_repeats,
                               threshold,
                               n_top_features = c(),
                               model_type
){
  external_perf_df = NULL
  global_perf_df = NULL
  
  external_conf_table_list = list()
  global_conf_table_list = list()
  
  global_coef_df = NULL
  
  
  threshold_df = df %>% filter(Conc. > threshold) %>% 
    select(-c(Conc., Replicates))
  
  num_feature_array = c(1, n_top_features)
  
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
    global_kfold = createFolds(threshold_df[[target]], k = k1)
    
    for (global_fold in 1:k1) {
      external_coef_df = NULL
      global_train = threshold_df[-global_kfold[[global_fold]], ]
      global_test = threshold_df[global_kfold[[global_fold]], ]
      
      external_resample = rf_resampling_function(
        target = target,
        dataset = global_train,
        n_folds = k2,
        perf_df = external_perf_df,
        coef_df = external_coef_df,
        conf_table_list = external_conf_table_list,
        transformation = c("scale", "center"),
        model_type = "rf"
        )
      external_perf_df = external_resample$perf_df
      external_coef_df = external_resample$coef_df
      external_conf_table_list = external_resample$conf_table_list
    # Next I need to average the importance and identify the top n pairs
    # SORTING COEFS AND DOWNSELECTING GLOBAL DF BASED ON EXTERNAL RESAMPLING
    # Easier just to call this regardless since it's really fast   
      avg_coefs = data.frame("avg_importance" = colMeans(external_coef_df))
      avg_coefs = avg_coefs %>% arrange(desc(avg_importance))
      avg_coefs$Pairs = row.names(avg_coefs)
      
      max_features = length(avg_coefs$avg_importance)
      num_feature_array[1] = max_features
      num_feature_array = num_feature_array[which(num_feature_array <= max_features)]
      print(num_feature_array)
      print(num_feature_array)
      global_resample = multi_feature_global_rf_resampling(
        target = target,
        train = global_train,
        test = global_test,
        sorted_coefs = avg_coefs,
        num_feature_list = num_feature_array,
        perf_df = global_perf_df,
        coef_df = global_coef_df,
        conf_table_list = global_conf_table_list,
        transformation = c("scale", "center"),
        model_type = 'rf'
      )
      global_conf_table_list = global_resample$conf_table_list
      global_coef_df = global_resample$coef_df
      global_perf_df = global_resample$perf_df
    }
  }
  
  return(list("external_conf_tables" = external_conf_table_list,
              "external_coef_df" = external_coef_df,
              "external_performance" = external_perf_df,
              "global_conf_tables" = global_conf_table_list,
              "global_coef_df" = global_coef_df,
              "global_performance" = global_perf_df
              # "global_coef_plot" = global_coef_plot
              ))
}
```

```{r}
rank_pairs = function(coef_results, model){
  ranked_pairs = NULL
  for (coef_df in coef_results){
    coef_df = na.replace(coef_df, 0)
    
    piv_df = coef_df %>% 
      group_by(n_features) %>% 
      filter(n_features == 10 |
               n_features == 5) %>% 
      summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = T)) %>% 
      pivot_longer(cols = -n_features,
                   names_to = "cAb",
                   values_to = "Importance")
      

    dAb_name = regexpr(".+(?=_)",piv_df$cAb, perl = T)
    dAb_name = unique(regmatches(piv_df$cAb, dAb_name))
    piv_df$dAb = dAb_name
    
    cab_dab_df = piv_df %>% mutate(across("cAb", ~gsub(".*_", "",.)))

    # Cleaning and ordering data frame, then adding a rank to each cab by dab
    # and n_features. The ranks are inverted (i.e. the most important has the 
    # highest rank) and since both 5 and 10 pair subsets are included in the
    # columns
    top_pairs = cab_dab_df %>% 
      group_by(n_features) %>% 
      slice_head(n=10) %>% 
      filter(Importance != 0) %>% 
      relocate(dAb, .after = n_features) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      group_by(n_features, dAb) %>% 
      arrange_at("Importance", desc, .by_group = T) %>% 
      mutate(rank = rank(Importance))
    
    if (is.null(ranked_pairs)){
      ranked_pairs = top_pairs
    }
    else {
      ranked_pairs = ranked_pairs %>% bind_rows(top_pairs)
    }
  }
  ranked_pairs$Model = model
  return(ranked_pairs)
}
rf_ranked_pairs = rank_pairs(all_rf_coef_results, 'rf')
pls_ranked_pairs = rank_pairs(all_pls_coef_results, 'pls')

small_subset_summed_ranks = small_subset_ranked_coefs %>% 
  group_by(dAb, cAb) %>% 
  summarise(across(rank, sum)) %>% 
  arrange_at("rank",desc, .by_group = T) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(across(1:2, as.factor))

  group_by(dAb, cAb) %>% 
  summarise(across(rank, sum)) %>% 
  arrange_at("rank",desc, .by_group = T) %>%

  filter(!(dAb %in% bad_dabs))
```
